name: Bitter Wife
overview: Scripture reveals that God desires peace and restoration in relationships, promising a hopeful future beyond bitterness (Jeremiah 29:11). The call to forgive others, as God forgives us, is essential to overcoming resentment and bitterness (Matthew 6:14, 18:21). Jesus teaches the importance of self-examination before judging others (Matthew 7:3), reminding believers that with God all difficult changes, including healing bitter relationships, are possible (Matthew 19:26). Ultimately, nothing hidden will remain concealed, encouraging honesty and openness in addressing relational struggles (Matthew 10:26).
